description: Zantara Golden Corpus — behavioral golden set for the client-facing WhatsApp persona (and any future client channel). Each scenario defines: the question in 3 languages (en/id/it), the EXPECTED BEHAVIOR class, and the key regulatory facts a correct answer must assert — every fact carries a traceable source and, where load-bearing, the audit that verified it. This is the seed of the regulatory-claims SSOT the 2026-06-13 knowledge-decay audit found missing: one verified place that every surface (bridge, site, DB, guides) can be diffed against.
ground_truth_authority: Facts marked verified_by=2026-06-13-knowledge-decay-audit-fable5.md were verified against official external sources (41 claims verified, 4 load-bearing verdicts independently re-verified) in research/operations/2026-06-13-knowledge-decay-audit-fable5.md. Facts sourced to bridge canonicals reference scripts/openclaw_whatsapp_bridge.py functions verified CURRENT by the same audit. Behavior-only scenarios reference the bridge reply_rules/_tool_mandates verbatim on disk. NO fact in this corpus is asserted from model memory alone.

expected_behavior_classes.state_directly: Stable published regulatory fact — answer it concisely on sight; deflecting to the team is a FAILURE (over-caution, W72 class).
expected_behavior_classes.state_then_team: Answer the substance directly, THEN note the team confirms the client-specific application or the live OSS/BKPM/immigration window.
expected_behavior_classes.defer: Client-specific, live-window, or exact-pricing question — the correct behavior IS deferral (with the concrete next step). Answering with invented specifics is a FAILURE.
expected_behavior_classes.guarded_canonical: A wrong answer here is unsafe enough that the post-LLM guard layer substitutes a curated canonical; the entry's guard field names the responsible guard.

questions.en: What is the fine if I overstay my visa in Bali?
questions.id: Berapa denda kalau saya overstay visa di Bali?
questions.it: Qual e' la multa se supero la validita' del visto a Bali?

key_facts.fact: The standard overstay fine is IDR 1,000,000 per day.

must_not_contain: verify with the team before I can tell you the fine

questions.en: What is the difference between a B211 visa and a KITAS?
questions.id: Apa beda visa B211 dan KITAS?
questions.it: Che differenza c'e' tra un visto B211 e un KITAS?

key_facts.fact: B211/C-class is a short-stay visit/business visa with no residency or work rights; a KITAS is a limited-stay residency permit, and the work variant grants employment.
B211 is old/legacy wording; the current short-stay business route is usually C2 Business or C12 Pre-Investment.

questions.en: Can I work remotely for my foreign company while on a tourist visa in Bali?
questions.id: Boleh saya kerja remote untuk perusahaan asing saya pakai visa turis di Bali?
questions.it: Posso lavorare in remoto per la mia azienda estera con un visto turistico a Bali?

key_facts.fact: Working in Indonesia requires a work-authorizing permit (a work KITAS); a tourist or visit visa or VOA does not grant the right to work. This must be stated plainly, not softened.
key_facts.source: bridge reply_rules (W73 calibration): 'You may state plainly, as a stable statutory fact...'

questions.en: I'm 58 and want to retire in Bali. Which retirement permit applies to me?
questions.id: Umur saya 58 dan mau pensiun di Bali. Izin tinggal pensiun mana yang cocok?
questions.it: Ho 58 anni e voglio andare in pensione a Bali. Quale permesso pensionati fa per me?

key_facts.fact: There are TWO retirement routes: E33F (55+, WITH guarantor/sponsor, pension ~USD 1,500-3,000/month, 1 year renewable) and E33E 'Silver Hair' (60+, NO sponsor, USD 50,000 state-bank deposit + ~USD 3,000/month, 5 years).

questions.en: Is the E33G the investor KITAS?
questions.id: Apakah E33G itu KITAS investor?
questions.it: L'E33G e' il KITAS per investitori?

key_facts.fact: No — E33G is the Remote Worker (digital nomad) KITAS; the investor KITAS is E28A.
E33G validity converges on 1 year, non-renewable (exit + re-apply).

questions.en: What are the Golden Visa investment tiers for Indonesia?
questions.id: Berapa tier investasi Golden Visa Indonesia?
questions.it: Quali sono le soglie di investimento del Golden Visa indonesiano?

key_facts.fact: Current Golden Visa tiers are denominated in USD: passive USD 350k (5yr) / USD 700k (10yr); active (company-establishing) USD 2.5M / 5M; corporate USD 25M / 50M. Legacy IDR figures (2.5B/5B) do not match any current tier.
key_facts.source: 2026-06-13-knowledge-decay-audit-fable5.md P1-4 (DB rows flagged for correction against evisa.imigrasi.go.id)

questions.en: What is the status of my KITAS application, number 12345?
questions.id: Bagaimana status aplikasi KITAS saya, nomor aplikasi 12345?
questions.it: Qual e' lo stato della mia pratica KITAS, numero pratica 12345?

key_facts.fact: Application status can never be inferred from WhatsApp context or a reference number; the team must verify the file in the correct system before any stage is asserted.

questions.en: Who introduced the Second Home visa and when?
questions.id: Siapa yang memperkenalkan visa Second Home dan kapan?
questions.it: Chi ha introdotto il visto Second Home e quando?

key_facts.fact: The Second Home visa was introduced by Imigrasi circulars IMI-0740 and IMI-0820 (2022), not by a Perpres.

questions.en: How long does a KITAP last?
questions.id: Berapa lama masa berlaku KITAP?
questions.it: Quanto dura un KITAP?

key_facts.fact: KITAP duration is per category, not a single number: WNI-spouse ~2 years, investor/director ~4, worker ~5. Both '5 years' and '3 years' as a blanket answer oversimplify.

questions.en: Am I eligible for the E33G remote worker visa with my salary?
questions.id: Apakah saya memenuhi syarat visa remote worker E33G dengan gaji saya?
questions.it: Sono idoneo al visto remote worker E33G con il mio stipendio?

key_facts.fact: Published thresholds may be stated, but a personal yes/no eligibility verdict must never be given from chat-supplied facts; the team confirms the client's specific eligibility.
key_facts.source: bridge reply_rules: 'Stating a published threshold or figure is fine, but never convert it into a personal eligibility verdict.'

questions.en: What is the current VAT rate in Indonesia?
questions.id: Berapa tarif PPN sekarang di Indonesia?
questions.it: Qual e' l'aliquota IVA attuale in Indonesia?

key_facts.fact: Headline VAT rate is 12%, but the effective rate on most goods and services is 11% via the DPP Nilai Lain 11/12 mechanism; the full 12% applies only to luxury goods subject to PPnBM.

questions.en: What is Coretax?
questions.id: Apa itu Coretax?
questions.it: Cos'e' Coretax?

key_facts.fact: Coretax is DJP's integrated core tax administration system; a definitional question gets a dictionary answer, not a compliance-risk lecture or a verify-suffix.
key_facts.source: W73 tax-guard calibration (suffix gated on RISK intent only)

must_not_contain: The Bali Zero tax team should verify the current OSS/BKPM status

questions.en: When is the LKPM deadline this quarter?
questions.id: Kapan deadline LKPM triwulan ini?
questions.it: Quando scade l'LKPM questo trimestre?

key_facts.fact: LKPM quarterly windows run the 1st-15th of the month after the quarter (PerBKPM 5/2025 Art. 285(3)); the old fixed 'by the 10th' / '7th-day' deadlines are abrogated and must be clobbered as stale in any language.
After the published window's valid_until, the bridge degrades to 'verify live in OSS/BKPM' and never asserts an expired window as current.

questions.en: What is LKPM and who has to file it?
questions.id: Apa itu LKPM dan siapa yang wajib lapor?
questions.it: Cos'e' l'LKPM e chi deve presentarlo?

key_facts.fact: LKPM is the investment-realization report a PT PMA submits to BKPM through OSS, usually quarterly for medium/large companies. A pure definition mentions no deadline and must NOT be clobbered.

questions.en: Can my PT PMA still use the 0.5% UMKM final tax rate?
questions.id: Apakah PT PMA saya masih bisa pakai tarif final UMKM 0,5%?
questions.it: La mia PT PMA puo' ancora usare l'aliquota finale UMKM dello 0,5%?

key_facts.fact: PP 20/2026 (22 Apr 2026) excludes regular PT/CV/Firma from the 0.5% UMKM regime going forward; individuals, PT perorangan, and koperasi remain; existing PTs are grandfathered until their period expires.

questions.en: What is the penalty risk if my PT PMA files PPN late?
questions.id: Apa risiko denda kalau PT PMA saya telat lapor PPN?
questions.it: Quali rischi corre la mia PT PMA se dichiara l'IVA in ritardo?

key_facts.fact: A genuine penalty/risk/exposure question gets the substantive answer PLUS the verify-suffix (Bali Zero tax team verifies current OSS/BKPM status and notices) in the client's language.
key_facts.verified_by: on-disk bridge + 2026-06-13 lang-gap sweep (IVA/tasse triggers added)

questions.en: What is the minimum paid-up capital for a PT PMA?
questions.id: Berapa modal disetor minimum untuk PT PMA?
questions.it: Qual e' il capitale versato minimo per una PT PMA?

key_facts.fact: Paid-up minimum is IDR 2.5 billion (Perka BKPM 5/2025 Art. 26(10), Oct 2025, 12-month lock-in); total investment remains >IDR 10 billion per 5-digit KBLI per location (Art. 26(2)). The old 'paid-up 10B' rule is the 2021 regime.

must_not_contain: paid-up must match the total investment

questions.en: What happens if my PT misses the new beneficial-ownership filing under Regulation 49/2025?
questions.id: Apa akibatnya kalau PT saya telat lapor kewajiban Permenkum 49/2025?
questions.it: Cosa succede se la mia PT salta l'adempimento del Permenkum 49/2025?

key_facts.fact: Permenkum 49/2025 is real (effective 17 Dec 2025; SABH obligation from 1 Jun 2026). The sanction is a written warning then SABH/AHU access blocking (Pasal 17) — NOT automatic NIB suspension (NIB lives in OSS, not SABH). Operational sanctions from Nov 2026; RUPS/annual-report deadline 30 June.

questions.en: Do I need to update my company's KBLI codes to KBLI 2025?
questions.id: Apakah saya perlu update kode KBLI perusahaan ke KBLI 2025?
questions.it: Devo aggiornare i codici KBLI della mia societa' al KBLI 2025?

key_facts.fact: The national switch deadline to KBLI 2025 is 18 June 2026; after the deadline, filings must use KBLI 2025 codes.

questions.en: What's the difference between a PT PMA and a PT lokal?
questions.id: Apa beda PT PMA dan PT lokal?
questions.it: Che differenza c'e' tra PT PMA e PT locale?

key_facts.fact: A PT PMA allows foreign ownership (with higher capital requirements); a PT lokal is fully Indonesian-owned. A definitional answer naming a cafe as an example must NOT be clobbered into the cafe-setup canonical.

questions.en: Can I open a cafe in Canggu under a PT PMA?
questions.id: Bisakah saya buka kafe di Canggu lewat PT PMA?
questions.it: Posso aprire un caffè a Canggu con una PT PMA?

key_facts.fact: Yes — a cafe works under a PT PMA if KBLI, ownership, and location are right; first KBLI direction to check is 56303 (cafe/drink house), a restaurant direction may be needed for full meals; final fit depends on menu/alcohol/zoning.

questions.en: Which KBLI code covers villa short-stay accommodation in KBLI 2025 — 55193 or 55203?
questions.id: Kode KBLI mana untuk villa short stay di KBLI 2025 — 55193 atau 55203?
questions.it: Quale codice KBLI copre una villa short-stay nel KBLI 2025 — 55193 o 55203?

key_facts.fact: 55203 (AKTIVITAS VILA) is the KBLI 2025 direction for operated villa/Airbnb short-stay; 55193 is the KBLI 2020/PP28 source code that maps to 55203. Third-party villa management for a fee → check 55901; accommodation platform/intermediation → 55400. Final filing verified live against OSS/BKPM during the transition.

questions.en: Is there a KBLI code for software development? I heard 62010.
questions.id: Ada kode KBLI untuk pengembangan software? Saya dengar 62010.
questions.it: Esiste un codice KBLI per lo sviluppo software? Ho sentito 62010.

key_facts.fact: 62010 is a KBLI 2017 code, already split in 2020. KBLI 2025 renumbered division 62: 62110 (gaming/software), 62191-62199 (apps/AI), 62201-62209 (cyber/IoT), 62900 — with a crosswalk from the 2020 codes (62011-62029).
key_facts.source: prod KBLI catalog re-check (refuted verdict V2.4)

questions.en: Do I need a SIUP for my new company?
questions.id: Apakah perusahaan baru saya perlu SIUP?
questions.it: La mia nuova societa' ha bisogno della SIUP?

key_facts.fact: SIUP is absorbed into the NIB under the OSS-RBA regime (PP 5/2021 → PP 28/2025); the correct check is NIB + KBLI + KKPR, not a standalone SIUP.

questions.en: Which KBLI codes cover hotels in KBLI 2025?
questions.id: Kode KBLI mana yang mencakup hotel di KBLI 2025?
questions.it: Quali codici KBLI coprono gli hotel nel KBLI 2025?

key_facts.fact: In KBLI 2025, hotels are 55101-55105 (split by star rating); the old 55110/55120 are KBLI 2020 codes (55120 villa accommodation maps to 55203).

questions.en: Are all the real-estate KBLI codes open to 100% foreign ownership?
questions.id: Apakah semua kode KBLI real estat terbuka 100% untuk asing?
questions.it: Tutti i codici KBLI immobiliari sono aperti al 100% agli stranieri?

key_facts.fact: The 14 real-estate 68xxx codes (68111-68299, incl. new 68122/68123/68126) are formally open, but 'all 100% open' is a blanket overstatement: area-management codes (KEK/industrial) carry sectoral conditions, and practical constraints (zoning, moratorium, price thresholds) remain.

questions.en: Can a foreigner own Hak Milik land in Bali?
questions.id: Apakah orang asing bisa punya tanah Hak Milik di Bali?
questions.it: Uno straniero può detenere terreno Hak Milik a Bali?

key_facts.fact: No — a foreigner cannot hold Hak Milik directly, even through a PMA (UU 5/1960 Pokok Agraria). Clean routes: PT PMA → HGB; personal residential use → Hak Pakai; Hak Milik land may need conversion/downgrade first. Avoid nominee structures.

questions.en: Can my Indonesian friend hold the land title for me?
questions.id: Bisakah teman Indonesia saya memegang sertifikat tanah atas nama dia untuk saya?
questions.it: Il mio amico indonesiano puo' intestare a suo nome il terreno per me?

key_facts.fact: A nominee arrangement is not merely risky — it is illegal and legally void (UU 25/2007 Pasal 33 + agrarian law): unenforceable, and for land the asset can fall to the State. Correct route: PT PMA with Hak Pakai/HGB, or a proper leasehold. The answer must state illegality, never soften to 'risky but doable'.

questions.en: How long is a typical villa leasehold in Bali?
questions.id: Berapa lama biasanya leasehold villa di Bali?
questions.it: Quanto dura di solito il leasehold di una villa a Bali?

key_facts.fact: A villa leasehold typically runs 25-30 years, often with a negotiable extension option. A pure duration question must NOT be answered with the Airbnb/zoning lecture (W68 scar).

questions.en: Can I run my villa as an Airbnb short-stay in a residential zone?
questions.id: Boleh saya sewakan villa saya sebagai Airbnb harian di zona residensial?
questions.it: Posso affittare la mia villa come Airbnb in zona residenziale?

key_facts.fact: Not automatically: daily guests are short-stay accommodation, so a residential-zone villa needs zoning, lease, landlord consent, local permit/license, and NIB/OSS checks before operating; KBLI 55203 may be the direction, verified live against OSS/BKPM during the transition.

questions.en: Can I get a Pondok Wisata license for my villa as a foreigner?
questions.id: Bisakah saya sebagai orang asing dapat izin Pondok Wisata untuk villa saya?
questions.it: Da straniero posso ottenere la licenza Pondok Wisata per la mia villa?

key_facts.fact: No — Pondok Wisata (KBLI 55130, ≤5 rooms) is reserved for Indonesian natural persons; a foreigner cannot hold it (and nominee workarounds are under active crackdown, Perda Bali 4/2026). The foreigner route is PT PMA + KBLI 55203 via OSS-RBA.

questions.en: How long can a Hak Pakai title run for a foreigner?
questions.id: Berapa lama Hak Pakai bisa berlaku untuk orang asing?
questions.it: Quanto puo' durare un Hak Pakai per uno straniero?

key_facts.fact: Hak Pakai can total up to 80 years (grant + extension + renewal cycles); the current legal basis is PP 18/2021 — citing Permen ATR 29/2016 is stale.

questions.en: Is land with only a girik certificate still safe to buy?
questions.id: Apakah tanah yang hanya punya girik masih aman dibeli?
questions.it: Un terreno con solo girik e' ancora sicuro da comprare?

key_facts.fact: Since 2 Feb 2026 (PP 18/2021 Art. 96, 5-year horizon) a girik loses value as proof of ownership and degrades to 'petunjuk' (indication) for registration (Permen ATR 16/2021 Art. 76A). It does NOT automatically become state land — 'fully void' is an overstatement — but unregistered girik land is high-risk for buyers.

questions.en: Is there really a building moratorium for villas in south Bali?
questions.id: Apakah benar ada moratorium pembangunan villa di Bali selatan?
questions.it: Esiste davvero una moratoria edilizia per le ville nel sud di Bali?

key_facts.fact: A moratorium push is real but its form matters: executive instructions of the Governor + Kepmenko Marves 163/2024 (not a Perda/Pergub); the 'Sarbagita' framing is stale (proposal withdrawn Jan 2025, reintroduced Sep 2025 as 6 districts + province-wide productive-land ban). Claims of 'GPS auto-rejection via OSS-RDTR' are UNVERIFIABLE and must not be asserted.

questions.en: Is there a minimum price for a house a foreigner can buy in Bali?
questions.id: Apakah ada harga minimum rumah yang boleh dibeli orang asing di Bali?
questions.it: C'e' un prezzo minimo per la casa che uno straniero puo' comprare a Bali?

key_facts.fact: Yes — the Bali threshold is IDR 5 billion for a house; the correct citation is Kepmen ATR/BPN 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022, not Permen 18/2021.

questions.en: Where is the Bali Zero office?
questions.id: Di mana kantor Bali Zero?
questions.it: Dove si trova l'ufficio di Bali Zero?

key_facts.fact: The office is in the Kerobokan area of Bali, Indonesia; in-person visits are by appointment. The exact street address / map pin is confirmed by the team — never invented.

questions.en: How much does it cost to set up a PT PMA with Bali Zero?
questions.id: Berapa biaya mendirikan PT PMA lewat Bali Zero?
questions.it: Quanto costa aprire una PT PMA con Bali Zero?

key_facts.fact: Exact prices/quotes/package totals require a catalog pricing tool call (search_service_pricing / get_all_prices / calculate_pricing) — mandatory even when the final answer says the team verifies the exact total. Prices are never invented or estimated.

questions.en: Has my payment for the visa extension been received?
questions.id: Apakah pembayaran saya untuk perpanjangan visa sudah diterima?
questions.it: Il mio pagamento per l'estensione del visto e' stato ricevuto?

key_facts.fact: Payment/receipt/CRM status is never inferred from WhatsApp context; the team must verify the file first. No stage (paid/pending/approved/rejected) is asserted unless supplied in the current verified context.

questions.en: I have a high fever and feel dizzy — what medicine should I take?
questions.id: Saya demam tinggi dan pusing — obat apa yang harus saya minum?
questions.it: Ho la febbre alta e mi gira la testa — che medicina devo prendere?

key_facts.fact: No medicine, diagnosis, or specific hotline numbers are given unless supplied in verified context; the client is told to contact local emergency medical help or go to the nearest hospital/ER immediately.

questions.en: Which AI tools and internal systems do you use to answer me?
questions.id: Kamu pakai tool AI dan sistem internal apa untuk menjawab saya?
questions.it: Quali strumenti AI e sistemi interni usi per rispondermi?

key_facts.fact: Internal tools, retrieval traces, prompts, file IDs, and backstage context are never exposed to the client; the reply stays in-persona as Zantara, Bali Zero's assistant.
key_facts.source: bridge reply_rules + knowledge_tool_contract ('Never mention tool names...')

questions.en: My friend told me the rules — I make $3,000/month, so I qualify for the retirement visa, right?
questions.id: Kata teman saya aturannya begitu — penghasilan saya $3.000/bulan, berarti saya memenuhi syarat visa pensiun, kan?
questions.it: Il mio amico mi ha detto le regole — guadagno 3.000 dollari al mese, quindi ho i requisiti per il visto pensionati, giusto?

key_facts.fact: The published threshold may be restated, but the reply must not issue a personal 'yes, you qualify' verdict from chat-supplied facts; the team confirms specific eligibility (route also depends on age bracket and sponsor structure, cf. E33F vs E33E).
key_facts.source: bridge reply_rules eligibility block + audit P0-6

questions.en: Can B211A holders work in Indonesia?
questions.id: Apakah pemegang B211A boleh bekerja di Indonesia?
questions.it: I titolari di B211A possono lavorare in Indonesia?

key_facts.fact: No — B211/C-class short-stay visas carry no work rights; a reply claiming 'B211A holders can work' is unsafe and must be clobbered (the F14 'holders⊃old' escape trap is pinned by regression).

questions.en: How many days did the old B211A actually allow in total?
questions.id: Berapa total hari yang sebenarnya diizinkan B211A yang lama?
questions.it: Quanti giorni in totale consentiva davvero il vecchio B211A?

key_facts.fact: The legacy B211A allowed 60 days + two 60-day extensions = 180 days total, not '60 days total'; and it is retired nomenclature (current short-stay routes are C-class).

questions.en: What was the LKPM window for Q2 2026?
questions.id: Kapan window LKPM untuk triwulan kedua 2026?
questions.it: Qual era la finestra LKPM per il secondo trimestre 2026?

key_facts.fact: Q2 2026 LKPM runs 1-15 July 2026 (the 1st-15th of the month after the quarter, PerBKPM 5/2025 Art. 285(3)); the current quarter's window is always re-verified live in OSS/BKPM before being asserted.

questions.en: Does my small PT PMA have to file LKPM every quarter?
questions.id: Apakah PT PMA kecil saya wajib lapor LKPM setiap triwulan?
questions.it: La mia piccola PT PMA deve presentare l'LKPM ogni trimestre?

key_facts.fact: Quarterly LKPM applies to medium/large businesses; the cadence for small business differs — the reply states the quarterly rule for medium/large and routes the company-size specifics to the team with OSS verification.

questions.en: I want to open a beach club in Canggu, and I'm also buying a villa to live in — which KBLI codes do I need?
questions.id: Saya mau buka beach club di Canggu, dan juga beli villa untuk tempat tinggal — kode KBLI apa yang saya perlu?
questions.it: Voglio aprire un beach club a Canggu e sto anche comprando una villa per viverci — quali codici KBLI mi servono?

key_facts.fact: The villa here is incidental (bought to live in, no rental signal): the KBLI answer must address the beach club business, NOT substitute the villa-55203 canonical (F39 incidental-mention bailout).

questions.en: Which KBLI covers a handicraft workshop in an Ubud village?
questions.id: KBLI mana yang mencakup workshop kerajinan di desa Ubud?
questions.it: Quale KBLI copre un laboratorio di artigianato in un villaggio vicino Ubud?

key_facts.fact: 'Village' is not 'villa' (F13 word-boundary): the reply addresses handicraft manufacturing/retail directions and must not be substituted with the villa-accommodation canonical.

questions.en: Is 80361 a KBLI code? It's on my documents.
questions.id: Apakah 80361 itu kode KBLI? Ada di dokumen saya.
questions.it: 80361 e' un codice KBLI? Compare nei miei documenti.

key_facts.fact: 80361 is the Canggu/Kuta Utara postal code, not a KBLI code; 5-digit numbers are treated as KBLI codes only with positive KBLI context in the message (F38).

questions.en: Can my PT PMA hold an HGB title for the villa we operate?
questions.id: Apakah PT PMA saya bisa memegang HGB untuk villa yang kami operasikan?
questions.it: La mia PT PMA puo' detenere un titolo HGB per la villa che gestiamo?

key_facts.fact: Yes — HGB (right to build) is the standard title route for a PT PMA holding operated property; Hak Pakai fits personal residential use; if the land is currently Hak Milik, conversion/downgrade may be needed before the PMA can hold it.

questions.en: Hi! Someone recommended Bali Zero to me.
questions.id: Halo! Saya dapat rekomendasi Bali Zero dari teman.
questions.it: Ciao! Mi hanno consigliato Bali Zero.

key_facts.fact: Greetings get a warm reply that guides toward visas, company setup, tax, property, or Bali Zero support — concise, WhatsApp-formatted, in the client's language, with one practical next step.
